exposure: Birth from a mother with a transplanted uterus
cohort: 2 children born to mothers after uterus transplantation
finding: Two children born prematurely to mothers with a transplanted uterus showed normal growth trajectory and neurodevelopmental outcomes at 3 years of follow-up.
mod_finding: Both children were born via cesarean section, one acute and one elective.
gest_age: One child born at 34 weeks and 6 days, the other at 36 weeks and 2 days
